caption:
When holding your place feels like a weight you can't put down — it's not yours. It's entrusted. (1 Timothy 1:12 devotional)

Whose place is this, anyway? Clutching it as mine and resenting why it came to me are two grips on the same weight.

Paul says his service was *appointed* — entrusted, not taken. Because this place is not mine, I am free. Stewards carry tasks, not the weight of ownership.

📌 Save this for your quiet time this week
